import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,sys,subprocess
L=Path.cwd()
def write(n,s):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
s=Path('ACTUALBRIEF.md').read_text().replace('Fifteen assigned original sources remain unread','Seventeen assigned original sources remain unread');write('ACTUALBRIEF.md',s)
x=json.loads(Path('read-access-inventory.json').read_text());x['originals_unread']=17;x['IDs_with_actual_primary_comparison']=4;write('read-access-inventory.json',json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n')
rows=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());assert len(rows)==20;P=json.loads(Path('literal-provenance.json').read_text())
for r in P:
 b=Path(f"originals/{r['id']}.jsonl").read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==r['raw_sha256'];assert b.endswith(b'\n');assert hashlib.sha256(Path(f"originals/{r['id']}.statement-token.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['raw_statement_token_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(Path(f"originals/{r['id']}.statement.txt").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['decoded_statement_utf8_sha256']
ledger=[json.loads(s) for s in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];prev='0'*64
for raw in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 z=json.loads(raw);assert z['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
for z in ledger:
 if z['event']=='success':assert hashlib.sha256(Path(z['destination']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==z['sha256']
receipts=[json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in Path('.').glob('*.receipt.json')];fail=[{'name':r['name'],'exit':r['exit'],'killed':r['killed']} for r in receipts if r['exit'] or r['killed']];assert fail==[{'name':'get_geodetic','exit':1,'killed':None}]
charges=[json.loads(s) for s in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];B=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert len(charges)==B['calls_used']==3;assert sum(len(z['queries']) for z in charges)==B['queries_used']==9
write('resource-access-audit.json',json.dumps({'prior_completed_receipts':len(receipts),'failures':fail,'max_sampled_group_rss_bytes':max(r['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'] for r in receipts),'max_recorded_child_cpu_seconds':max(r['child_cpu_cumulative_s'] for r in receipts),'max_recorded_wall_seconds':max(r['wall_s'] for r in receipts),'limit':'sampled/transient/native/writer limitations; no universal compliance claim','raw_token_decoded_bindings':20,'guard_hashchain_verified':len(ledger),'PDF_hashes_verified':4,'search_live_continuity_verified':'3calls9strings'},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Verified20 bindings, guard chain10rows,4PDF hashes,3search9strings; one403 receipt retained; original-unread count corrected to17.')
